text: actions core table: one row per contribution, text content. action one action_type: speech, question answer: member’s contribution. quote: passage read record, letter petition: speaker’s words. procedural: non-speech entry, “Mr Speaker took chair”. unresolved_interjection: interjection whose speaker source identify. Logical flags refine type. is_speech, is_question is_answer mark member’s substantive contributions, is_interjection marks interjections (including resolved ones, action_type = "speech"), has_quote marks actions contain quoted material. get_speeches() uses flags: default returns speeches, questions answers, leaves interjections . speech interrupted interjections, continued across pages, several actions. title: Search speeches for words and phrases — search_speeches_by_terms
text: Two-stage matching. exact = TRUE (default): Recall. database's full-text index (fts_main_actions, BM25) finds candidate turns within years . term split words way index splits text (lowercased, accents punctuation removed, digits dropped) stopwords "" "" dropped, "-sex marriage" searches sex marriage. index stems words, stage finds turns match exactly. Verification. candidate's content checked case-insensitive regular expression built term. Regex special characters matched literally ("LGBTIQ+" "C++" mean exactly ), whitespace inside phrase matches run whitespace, term must start end word boundary wherever first last character letter, digit underscore. n_hits total number occurrences terms turn. conjunctive = TRUE turn must contain every term; FALSE, least one. Terms indexed words. term words left stopwords digits dropped (example "" "1996"), index help, whole search scans content regular expressions alone, within filters. slower; one-line message says , score NA. exact = FALSE. Returns index's candidates : stemmed matches ("tariff" also finds "tariffs"), without regex check, n_hits NA. Turn types (B1) filters. get_speeches(): interjections left unless type includes "interjection", presiding-officer turns unless include_presiding = TRUE. Requirements. Search needs database's full-text index DuckDB fts extension. database index (fts_main_actions), call fails ausparl_db_error: use official released build database; ausparl never builds index. fts extension loaded, call fails ausparl_db_error saying install . fallback full regex scan either case. Words soft hyphen. index splits words every number, punctuation mark, symbol space ("budget—" gives budget ), word contains soft hyphen (U+00AD, usually invisible) stays one token, recall stage find parts .
